author: Dalks
body: Hello, my username is Dalks (Formally nathannatedog5). Last year on February 18th I went on Avicus and decided it was a good idea to cheat. I was banned and I immediately regretted it. I have since stopped hacking and I really want to play one of my favorite minecraft servers again. I can't say much else other than I'm sorry. Thank you :D!
